reason: Getting my evenings back sounds great, but I'm not letting an AI I've never heard of loose on my CRM and customer emails just because it says 'GDPR-compliant'. At most I'd poke at the free plan this month, not pay.
objection: Where does my customer data actually go, which AI models see it, is it hosted in the EU, and can I get a signed data processing agreement? One line saying 'GDPR-compliant' doesn't answer that.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial on my real tools that visibly saves me a few hours in the first week, plus a clear DPA with EU hosting and a reference from a Belgian or Dutch SME like mine.
